name: spiral/idempotency
description: Idempotency guarantees (AtLeastOnce lease / ExactlyOnce inbox) for Spiral Framework operations.

suggest.cycle/database: Use the bundled Cycle driver (lease/inbox storage over a Cycle DBAL connection) — required by everything under Spiral\Idempotency\Driver\Cycle.
suggest.cycle/transaction: Required by the bundled Cycle driver's inbox storage (single-transaction ExactlyOnce commit) — everything under Spiral\Idempotency\Driver\Cycle.
suggest.spiral/cycle-bridge: Integrate the idempotency tables into the Cycle ORM schema (cycle:migrate / cycle:sync) via CycleSchemaBootloader — also pulls cycle/schema-builder.
suggest.predis/predis: Default client for the Redis/Valkey lease backend (RedisLeaseConfig) — AtLeastOnce storage over a Redis-compatible server. Not needed when RedisCommands (Driver/Redis) is bound to an adapter over your own Redis client.
suggest.spiral/events: Make PSR-14 event listeners idempotent declaratively with #[Idempotent] via IdempotentListenerFactory, bound by EventsIdempotencyBootloader — a per-listener key, so one failing listener of a fan-out re-runs alone on the next dispatch.
suggest.spiral/interceptors: Make HTTP controller actions idempotent declaratively with the #[Idempotent] attribute via IdempotencyInterceptor (also needs a PSR-17 factory).
suggest.spiral/queue: Make queue/job handlers idempotent declaratively with #[Idempotent] via IdempotencyInterceptor bound in the 'queue' scope by QueueIdempotencyBootloader (Locked -> native job retry).
suggest.spiral/roadrunner-grpc: Make gRPC service methods idempotent declaratively with #[Idempotent] via IdempotencyInterceptor bound in the 'grpc' scope by GrpcIdempotencyBootloader (Locked -> ABORTED status with a google.rpc.RetryInfo detail, key from metadata). Pulls google/protobuf + google/common-protos, which the gRPC middleware use directly.
suggest.spiral/roadrunner-bridge: Runs the gRPC (and queue) dispatcher in a Spiral app: provides config/grpc.php with its `interceptors` list, the 'grpc' dispatcher scope and the invoker that IdempotencyInterceptor plugs into. Required to actually serve gRPC; no type of it is imported here.
